grammar.title: 星期 + number for days of the week
grammar.pattern: 星期 + number (一-六) / 星期 + 几?
grammar.explanation: 星期 (xīngqī) means "week", and adding a number one through six names that day of the week (星期一 = Monday). Ask which day it is with 星期几?. Sunday uses a different word, covered later.

grammar.title: 星期天 and 星期日 for Sunday
grammar.explanation: Unlike the numbered weekdays (星期一 through 星期六), Sunday breaks the pattern: it's 星期天 or, more formally, 星期日 — both mean the same thing and are used interchangeably.

sentences.en: What day of the week is it today?
